name: ES Overnight Session Profile Analysis
description: Overnight (18:00–09:30 ET) market profile and volume profile for ES futures. Computes POC, VAH, VAL from both volume and market (TPO) profiles using 0.25 tick size and 70% value area. Tracks overnight value area width as a volatility proxy. Event markers flag sessions with unusually wide overnight ranges (top 10% by VA width).
source:
# ES Overnight Session Profile Analysis
# Overnight = 18:00–09:30 ET (full Globex overnight)
# Volume profile + Market (TPO) profile, tick_size=0.25, 70% value area
# Tracks POC, VAH, VAL levels and VA width as overnight volatility proxy

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open = cont.o
volume = cont.v

# --- Overnight Session Window (18:00–09:30 ET) ---
overnight = session_window(
    session=Session(start='18:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(cont.o, cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

# --- Volume Profile (rolling 500 bars ≈ last 8.3 hrs of overnight) ---
# Max window_size is 500. At 1Min bars, this covers the European + US pre-market
# portion of the overnight — the most liquid and relevant part.
vol_profile = price_profile(
    window_size=500,
    tick_size=0.25,
    value_area_pct=0.7,
    mode=ProfileType.volume
)(cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

# --- Market (TPO) Profile (same window) ---
mkt_profile = price_profile(
    window_size=500,
    tick_size=0.25,
    value_area_pct=0.7,
    mode=ProfileType.market
)(cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

# --- Capture overnight levels at session close, persist through RTH ---
# Volume profile levels
on_vol_poc = ffill_day(where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, vol_profile.poc))
on_vol_vah = ffill_day(where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, vol_profile.vah))
on_vol_val = ffill_day(where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, vol_profile.val))
on_vol_width = ffill_day(where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, vol_profile.va_width))

# Market (TPO) profile levels
on_mkt_poc = ffill_day(where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, mkt_profile.poc))
on_mkt_vah = ffill_day(where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, mkt_profile.vah))
on_mkt_val = ffill_day(where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, mkt_profile.val))
on_mkt_width = ffill_day(where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, mkt_profile.va_width))

# --- Overnight session range and stats ---
on_range = ffill_day(where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, overnight.high - overnight.low))
on_volume_total = ffill_day(where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, overnight.volume))

# --- VA Width percentile for detecting unusually wide overnight sessions ---
# Use sparse (non-ffill) width for percentrank to avoid distortion
sparse_vol_width = where(overnight.closed and overnight.opened, vol_profile.va_width)
width_pctrank = percentrank(period=100)(sparse_vol_width)
is_wide_session = is_valid(width_pctrank) and width_pctrank > 90

# --- Timestamp for charts ---
ts = index().value

# --- CHART 1: Overnight Profile Levels (Volume POC + VAH/VAL) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Overnight Volume Profile Levels — Where Is Value?',
    category='Overnight Profile',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Price',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Vol POC', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Vol VAH', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Vol VAL', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(on_vol_poc, on_vol_vah, on_vol_val))

# --- CHART 2: Volume vs Market POC Comparison ---
xy_lines(
    title='Volume POC vs Market (TPO) POC — Do They Agree?',
    category='Overnight Profile',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Price',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Volume POC', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Market POC', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(on_vol_poc, on_mkt_poc))

# --- CHART 3: Overnight VA Width — Volatility Proxy ---
xy_lines(
    title='Overnight Value Area Width — How Volatile Is the Overnight?',
    category='Overnight Profile',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='VA Width (pts)',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Vol VA Width', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Mkt VA Width', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(on_vol_width, on_mkt_width))

# --- SUMMARY TABLE: Overnight Profile Stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Overnight Profile Summary',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Volume Profile', 'Market Profile', 'Session'],
        col_headers=['POC (Last)', 'VAH (Last)', 'VAL (Last)', 'VA Width (Median)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0)
        ]
    ),
    category='Overnight Profile',
    order=0
)(on_vol_poc, on_vol_vah, on_vol_val, sparse_vol_width,
  on_mkt_poc, on_mkt_vah, on_mkt_val, sparse_vol_width,
  on_range, on_volume_total, sparse_vol_width, sparse_vol_width)

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Unusually Wide Overnight Sessions ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Wide Overnight Session',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='VA Width', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Width %ile', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='ON Range', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='Vol POC', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(sparse_vol_width, width_pctrank, on_range, on_vol_poc, is_wide_session)
